# Data profile

*Arrives in Phase 1. Every chart on this page is generated by
`make docs-assets` from the built stores, and CI fails if regenerating them
produces a diff — so a chart cannot quietly drift from the data it describes.*

Planned charts:

1. **Value distributions per analyte**, with the reference and critical bands
   drawn — this is what the post-flight critical-value check is comparing
   against, made visible.
2. **Out-of-range share** by analyte, so the base rate the system operates at is
   explicit.
3. **Education-source coverage** — which LOINC codes and RxCUIs in the generated
   population resolved to a real MedlinePlus page, and which did not.

Chart 3 is the honest one. Some analytes and medications will have no vetted
public page, and the assistant declares that gap rather than filling it. Showing
the size of the gap up front is better than discovering it one question at a
time.
